resources.string: Key uses (above every previously used index)

Enter your seed phrase, key uses and the address of a Minima MegaMMR node.

WARNING: this app uses the NEW block-as-key-uses key system. A seed from the classic MinimaCore app produces DIFFERENT addresses here — coins held on classic addresses will NOT appear. Sweep funds out of the classic app instead of restoring its seed here.

For a block-mode wallet restore, enter a key-use floor above every index previously used by that wallet. The current chain height alone does not prove that an index is unused. Stop the original wallet before restoring.
